interactions.description: the dataset registry answers with the schema a dataset table was created from
a point read returns every column as text, and SQL NULL as an absent text

body.sql: SELECT "tenant_id" AS "tenant_id", "id" AS "id", "qty"::text AS "qty", "price"::text AS "price", encode(float8send("weight"), 'hex') AS "weight", "active"::text AS "active", "note" AS "note", encode("blob", 'hex') AS "blob", to_json("placed_at" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') #>> '{}' AS "placed_at", to_json("due") #>> '{}' AS "due", "ref"::text AS "ref", "attrs"::text AS "attrs", "card"::text AS "card" FROM "hobo_fixture_capture"."hobo_fixture_orders" WHERE "tenant_id" = $1::text AND "id" = $2::text

interactions.description: a migration authority presents its fence token for one transaction only
an upsert casts every parameter in the statement; SQL NULL is an absent text

body.sql: INSERT INTO "hobo_fixture_capture"."hobo_fixture_orders" ("tenant_id", "id", "qty", "price", "weight", "active", "note", "blob", "placed_at", "due", "ref", "attrs", "card") VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::bigint, $4::numeric, $5::double precision, $6::boolean, $7::text, decode($8::text, 'hex'), $9::timestamptz, $10::date, $11::uuid, $12::jsonb, $13::jsonb) ON CONFLICT ("tenant_id", "id") DO UPDATE SET "qty" = EXCLUDED."qty", "price" = EXCLUDED."price", "weight" = EXCLUDED."weight", "active" = EXCLUDED."active", "note" = EXCLUDED."note", "blob" = EXCLUDED."blob", "placed_at" = EXCLUDED."placed_at", "due" = EXCLUDED."due", "ref" = EXCLUDED."ref", "attrs" = EXCLUDED."attrs", "card" = EXCLUDED."card"

interactions.description: the watermark is recorded in the same transaction as the changes it covers

body.sql: INSERT INTO "hobo_fixture_capture"."hobo_data_watermarks" (dataset, source, log_position) VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text) ON CONFLICT (dataset, source) DO UPDATE SET log_position = EXCLUDED.log_position

interactions.description: a conditional apply moves the watermark only from the position the applier named

body.sql: UPDATE "hobo_fixture_capture"."hobo_data_watermarks" SET log_position = $3::text WHERE dataset = $1::text AND source = $2::text AND log_position = $4::text

interactions.description: a conditional apply that names a watermark the store has moved past matches no row
interactions.providerState: another applier has moved the watermark

body.sql: UPDATE "hobo_fixture_capture"."hobo_data_watermarks" SET log_position = $3::text WHERE dataset = $1::text AND source = $2::text AND log_position = $4::text

interactions.description: the decoding call's session settings are pinned for its transaction

body.sql: SELECT set_config('TimeZone', 'UTC', true) AS pinned_0, set_config('DateStyle', 'ISO, YMD', true) AS pinned_1, set_config('IntervalStyle', 'postgres', true) AS pinned_2, set_config('extra_float_digits', '1', true) AS pinned_3, set_config('bytea_output', 'hex', true) AS pinned_4

interactions.description: the slot reports what it has released, and whether the log is quiescent

body.sql: SELECT confirmed_flush_lsn::text AS confirmed, pg_current_wal_flush_lsn()::text AS flushed, pg_current_wal_insert_lsn()::text AS inserted FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = $1::name

interactions.description: the decoding call returns whole transactions of pgoutput messages as hex text, without consuming them

body.sql: SELECT encode(data, 'hex') AS data FROM pg_logical_slot_peek_binary_changes($1::name, NULL, $2::integer, 'proto_version', '1', 'publication_names', $3::text)

interactions.description: a write the store's fence refuses fails with the fence SQLSTATE and none of the server's text
interactions.providerState: the dataset is fenced and the session presents no token
